games.summary: This game is a simple game. But it was not easy to play. Some of you may have found that stalemate will continue playing. But it will be fun when you go through with it if you like solitaire game on windows, it will be the same.Klondike is a patience game (solitaire card game). Many people refer to Klondike as patience or solitaire, it being one of the better known of the family of patience games.RulesTaking a shuffled standard 52-card deck of playing cards (without Jokers), one upturned card is dealt on the left of the playing area, then six down turned cards (from left to right). On top of the down turned cards, an upturned card is dealt on the left-most down turned pile, and down turned cards on the rest until all piles have an upturned card. The piles should look like the figure to the right.The four foundations (light rectangles in the upper right of the figure) are built up by suit from Ace (low in this game) to King, and the tableau piles can be built down by alternate colors, and partial or complete piles can be moved if they are built down by alternate colors also. Any empty piles can be filled with a King or a pile of cards with a King. The aim of the game is to build up a stack of cards starting with 2 and ending with King, all of the same suit. Once this is accomplished, the goal is to move this to a foundation, where the player has previously placed the Ace of that suit. Once the player has done this, they will have "finished" that suit, the goal being, of course, to finish all suits, at which time the player will have won. There are different ways of dealing the remainder of the deck:Turning three cards at once to the waste, either allowing three passes through the deck or placing no limit on passes through the deck.Turning three cards at once, reversing the order of each group of three as the cards are dealt.Turning only one card at a time, but only passing through the deck once.Turning only one card at a time, but placing no limit on passes through the deck.Turning three cards at once to the waste with no limit on passes through the deck, but allowing the player to switch once to a single pass through the deck one card at a time; after that single pass, however, the player cannot go back to turning three cards at a time and can turn over no more cards from the waste.Please see more details.http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Klondike_(solitaire)

This is a horror game unlike any other. Explore the deepest fears that come from The Color Fun Coloring Show.

Today on The Color Fun Coloring Show they want viewers to help them find out who is breaking into their house. Each new Fear that breaks in will hunt you down! All the show wants to know is what color they show you!

games.name: CORPSE FARM
games.summary: CORPSE FARM is a horror farming simulator set in a fleshy, surrealist environment. Grow and harvest humanoid creatures to appease your god. Fight off pests and make sure your crops don’t become infected…

games.name: Cow Abduction Frenzy
games.summary: Hop into your alien ship and get ready for a frantic bullet hell challenge! Use time-bending and cloaking abilities to rescue cows from the clutches of beef-hungry butchers before your energy depletes. Can you abduct the herd and escape the farm alive?

games.name: Cry Pic.
games.summary:
This is an action shooter game where the main focus is fighting large enemies (bosses).

Dodge the dizzying amount of enemy bullets while dealing damage to the enemy.

Destroy the enemy.

games.name: FFFF : Fatal Five Finger Fillet Demo
FOOD FIGHT!
games.summary: Throw food. Dodge food. Dodge the check. In this arcade style party game you and your friends make a big, expensive mess while trying not to get caught by the waiter.

games.name: idle koi!
games.summary: Hatch koi eggs, breed unique bloodlines, evolve rare traits, and send 3-koi teams into idle battles. Build a living collection where genes, rarity, lineage, and battle growth decide every koi's value.

games.name: In Falsus - Virtual Singers Song Pack
Isekai: Demon King
games.summary: A brutal tactical turn-based RPG where heroes grow through how you play. Summon and train unique fighters, master evolving active and passive skills, survive permadeath expeditions, build your Sanctuary, tame creatures, inherit Legacies, and battle in cross-platform PvP.

games.name: Monster Museum: Tidy Up the collection!
MyMeow
games.summary: 一只猫咪住进你的桌面，在屏幕角落自由生活、陪你工作。每天摸摸、喂喂、逗逗，看它从奶猫慢慢长成御猫；布置猫窝、收集品种、养一整窝猫，还能派它们出门打工攒鱼干。零压力——不会饿死、不会走丢，关机离线也安心。

games.name: Okko The Exiled
games.summary:
Okko The Exiled is an action-packed adventure where you stomp, launch, and bash your way through Kutala, a land of demons, on a quest to defeat the Demon Lord Yalda and link Okko’s isolated world with the heavens.

After 1,000 years of concealment, Okko is ready to wield the Mighty Fang and take down Kutala’s lords one by one. 

Defeat powerful foes, overcome obstacles, and unleash your heart as Okko fights to fulfill an ancient oath.

games.name: Queueue
games.summary: An abstract, tile-based puzzle game where the moves you make are for turns not-yet done. Dodging through traps you will arrive at 2 turns in the future quickly becomes a mind-bending puzzle as the levels grow more complex. How hard can a level with only 6 tiles be?

games.name: Shole Soccer
games.summary: Shole Soccer is physics-based online soccer game with 1v1-3v3 matches where ball obeys physics - and your friends don't obey rules. Kick, stun or tackle your way to victory over your friends.

games.name: SoulMonsters Ariel, Queen of the Sea
Street Light Simulator 2026
games.summary: A relaxing ambient simulation where a street lamp reflects you real-world system time. Creating a calm background scene for working, studying, or unwinding.

games.name: Technoidium
games.summary: Ener the Techno Maze and master the swing of your dual directional combat tandem whip tether weapon. Seek and destroy the Corrupted Mechanoids.

games.name: To Raise a King
games.summary: You are a young king with twenty four years to raise a kingdom, choose your queen, prepare your heir, and hand the crown on well. A turn based medieval strategy told in painted storybook chapters, with a fully voiced cast and six queens whose stories reshape your reign.

games.name: Ultraquarium
games.summary: ULTRAQUARIUM is a casual aquarium sim that lets you create your own fish and decorations. Purchase fish, satisfy their needs and they shall repay you in kind. Want two Gregs? You can't have two Gregs.

games.name: Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler
games.summary:
Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler is 2.5D side-scrolling beat-'em-up where players experience the thrill of multiple unrivaled heroes, each with unique abilities. Master martial arts, unleash powerful skills, and conquer epic bosses. With local co-op for up to 4 players, team up for intense combat and a truly unforgettable adventure.

Set in medieval Indonesia, this game transports players to an era where powerful kingdoms ruled over vast archipelagos. Inspired by Indonesian folklore and mythology, legendary tales come to life through epic battles, brought together with stunning visuals that blend 2D and 3D elements.

Every chapter unfolds a new story, introducing fresh challenges, characters, and environments to explore. As the journey progresses, uncover deeper lore and unexpected twists that shape the world around you.

games.name: 气运之子The One of Fortune
Gears of War: E-Day
games.summary:
Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​ 

Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​

Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.summary:
1499. Paris is engulfed as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.

Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, Trevor Belmont’s successor ventures into the burning streets and the looming castle to hunt down the beasts.

Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation...?

Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow a young Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: Phantom Blade Zero
games.summary: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.
